records.text: Everybody got to sue Candace (Candace Owens). You know, it's like that show Everybody Hates Chris: Everybody Sues Candace. I gotta have like a, I don't know, we gotta make something, a little AI thing: Everybody Sues Candace. Feeling so bad for myself. Nemus Outis writes: "Candace is divine providence in action. P.S. John Mappin is a proper legend, a top bloke and an absolute diamond. He's a sort of chap who would help you move a sofa without expecting a pint of seller [word uncertain] after. Sovereignty is ours. Let's, let's keep it signed [phrase uncertain]."
